title: Nonlinear evolution in Galileon EFTs: Regularization and screening
summary: In a scalar effective field theory (EFT) with Galileon symmetry, we distinguish the strong-field expansion from the derivative expansion and study spherically symmetric classical nonlinear dynamics. More concretely, we consider two models related via perturbative field redefinitions: one with second-order equations that can also exhibit screening, and one that includes a higher-derivative term that introduces a propagating ghost.
